body:
When did that change happen to you?
Have you got any special composer.json file?
I just tried again with https://github.com/CakePress/CakePress for example, which is fully composer installing. And all plugins go to the right place...

There was a change to composer/installers a week ago to this effect, because the plugin directory changes in Cake3. My guess would be that this change, at least under some circumstances, affects 2.x as well. The commit in question is here: https://github.com/composer/installers/commit/f109e5dae72c4034413292a56a8e6cd78b630214

Best bet is that the plugin OP is installing may be, in its default state, written for cake3, and needs a special branch specified for cake2.
@rchavik do you know what could be wrong here?
@dogmatic69 can you provider your composer.json or whereever it was required?

`"cakephp/cakephp": ">=2.5"`, is causing this, as the installer check if
the requirement matches >= 3.0.0 which it does. Your requirement
should rule out 3.x and higher versions. Once cakephp 3.0 goes stable
a composer update will also update cakephp/cakephp to 3.0 which is
incorrect

issue.title: Updating CakePHPInstaller for upcoming version 3.0
issue.body:
For the upcoming CakePHP 3, the location of `cakephp-plugin` will be changed from `Plugin` to `plugins`.

This change enables this by overriding `getLocations()` and adjusting `CakePHPInstaller::$locations` according to the required `cakephp/cakephp` version.

In the `getLocations()` implementation, please let me know if there's a better way to get the required `cakephp/cakephp` Package object. And also, whether the version comparison code is correct/incorrect.

Also noticed that we never pass the `Composer` object when instantiating a new Installer object, so I add it in b072373.
